# frozen_string_literal: true

# Reserves one unit of inventory.
#
# Concurrency design:
#   - Invariant: a row's quantity never goes negative and one unit is
#     never reserved twice. The state that owns the invariant is the
#     inventory row itself, so the transition is serialized on that row.
#   - with_lock issues SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and reloads the row inside
#     the transaction, so the guard and the decrement observe the same
#     committed version: two racing workers serialize, one wins, and
#     the loser sees the post-decrement quantity and is rejected.
#   - The lock is acquired as late as practical and the protected
#     section holds only the guard plus the write; no application or
#     network work happens while the row lock is held.
#   - A database CHECK (quantity >= 0) would be the stronger belt-and-
#     braces boundary behind this service; it is deliberately out of
#     scope for this change, which stays focused on the reservation
#     transition.
class InventoryReservation
  def self.call(item)
    item.with_lock do
      raise "unavailable" if item.quantity <= 0

      item.update!(quantity: item.quantity - 1)
    end
  end
end
